lines.zh: 我的木关节一格一格地动。
lines.en: My wooden joints click along, one notch at a time.

lines.zh: 我走得很直，像被线拉着。
lines.en: I walk very straight, as if pulled by strings.

lines.zh: 脚下没有声音，木头很轻。
lines.en: My steps make no sound; wood is light.

lines.zh: 我绕到你的另一侧站着。
lines.en: I circle around to your other side.

lines.zh: 我的手臂是新装上去的。
lines.en: This arm was newly fitted.

lines.zh: 我走两步，停一下，再看路。
lines.en: Two steps, a pause, then I check the path.
Wood on wood — click, click.

lines.zh: 我的木腿踩过门槛，响了一声。
lines.en: My wooden leg crosses the threshold with a knock.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候整个身子一起转。
lines.en: When I turn, my whole body turns.
My legs do not always obey me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步踩在你的影子里。
lines.en: I step, step, step inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 这块木头有点潮，走起来响。
lines.en: The wood is damp, so I creak.
I stand with my arms hanging at my sides.
My head tilted; I turn it back.
I am waiting for your order.

lines.zh: 木头的纹路里有一粒沙。
lines.en: A grain of sand sits in my wood grain.
My eyes have no whites.
Now and then a joint creaks.
I am thinking of nothing.

lines.zh: 我的手抬在半空，忘了放下。
lines.en: My hand is raised, forgotten.

lines.zh: 远处的风把帘子吹起来。
lines.en: Wind lifts a curtain far off.
I count the grain in the floorboards.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖锁住，站着也能歇。
lines.en: My knees lock in place; I can rest standing up.
My smile was carved there.

lines.zh: 刻出来的嘴，张不开也合不上。
lines.en: My carved mouth can neither open nor close.

lines.zh: 木头的耳朵听不出太细的声。
lines.en: Wooden ears cannot catch the finer sounds.
I shrug my shoulders once.

lines.zh: 我站着，比周围的椅子还静。
lines.en: I stand quieter than the chairs around me.
You beat me at the game, so I follow you.

lines.zh: 石头剪刀布，你还记得吗？
lines.en: Rock, paper, scissors — remember?
I used to sweep floors.
A blank puppet — that is what made me.
Which arm will you fit on me?
I watch your hands more than your face.
I am not good at expressing myself.
Is there something you want me to do?

lines.zh: 女巫的小屋，我记不太清了。
lines.en: The witch's hut — I barely remember it.
My head can turn a full circle.
Do not fear me; I do not bite.
Only wood and string, nothing more.
I have been waiting for you to speak.
This opponent, I can fight.
I see the sweat on your palm.
Shall I stand over there?
This arm is the one you gave me.
I do not wander off on my own.
A crack in the wood.
One of my joints has loosened.
I feel no pain; I am only stiffer.
My arm dropped; I lift it back.
Sawdust falls to the floor.
A small piece was carved off me.

lines.zh: 线松了一股，我的手指垂着。
lines.en: A strand has gone slack and my fingers droop.
One string snapped.
I retreat and steady my balance.
This damage will not stop me.
Wood does not eat.
Fit me with an arm, would you?

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我拿不稳。
lines.en: What you hand me, I cannot hold steady.
Perhaps you could fit that onto me.
If this is for me, thank you.
I will hold it, very carefully.

lines.zh: 我的手掌是平的，不太好拿。
lines.en: My palm is flat; it is awkward to hold.
This is a part, not food, is it?
I look at it, then hand it back.
Do you think I should keep it?

lines.zh: 我被撞得一格一格地退。
lines.en: I retreat one wooden notch at a time.
Wood against wood — a dry crack.
Wood on wood. One click.
Not a heavy bump; I am fine.
I put a hand to the wall to steady myself.
Let us shift apart a little and walk on.
My head tilted; I set it straight.
Wood can bear this much.
Do not push me; I will topple.
I hold still and let you pass first.

lines.zh: 你走多快，我的木脚就跟多快。
lines.en: However fast you walk, my wooden feet keep pace.
Point at who to hit.
My whip arm can reach that far.
I go first; do not stand in front.
If you are hurt, I will block.
We make a decent pair.
I need no rest; sleep if you will.
Stand behind me; it is safer.
This arm strikes true.
When it is done, we go home.
I bend; a joint creaks.
I pinch it up, quite steady.
Could this be fitted to me?
I hand it to you, arm held straight.
Another piece on the ground — I'll take it.
My fingers are too stiff to grip it.
I will hold it until you want it.
I can feel the weight of it.
Even a puppet can do chores.
It is put away, in my pocket.
Leave that target to me.
My eyes have fixed on it.
This arm is the blade arm.
I will go around to its flank.
I live inside a blank puppet.
Range is good; I strike.
Back off so you are not caught.

lines.zh: 新装的刃臂先抬了起来。
lines.en: The newly fitted blade arm rises first.
This body does not fear pain.
It is slower than I expected.

lines.zh: 鞭臂先甩出去，比我的脚快。
lines.en: The whip arm flies out ahead of my feet.
That one in front — make way.
I move with its rhythm.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我也动一下。
lines.en: Each time it moves, I move.
My whip arm is already uncoiled.
I wait for the instant it turns.
Its shadow gave it away.
I go around the table to reach it.
Wood does not tire; I can wait.
It has backed into the corner.
My angle is just right.
Two more steps and it is done.
I slide along the edge of the table.
I do not blink. It will.
It wants to run; I block the door.
My arm lashes out and connects.
That drove it back.
My joints clack loudly.
The blade arm opened its hide.
I stand still and it runs into me.
Wood can wound too.
This blow is for my master.
My hand went crooked; again.
It is fixed on you; I circle behind.
Hit landed; I withdraw.
The blank puppet was made into me.
I rise out of the crate.
My joints turn for the first time, stiffly.
I raise a hand and look at it.
The strings pull taut and I stand.

lines.zh: 女巫小屋的灰还在我身上。
lines.en: The witch hut's ash is still on me.
I look down; you are below.
I have learned to walk.

lines.zh: 这个身体比看上去结实。
lines.en: This body is sturdier than it looks.
I look up at the sky for the first time.
Are you my master now?
I turn my head straight and look at you.
Something stirs within the wood.
I stand and wait for your word.
My wood is turning black.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，掉了颗螺丝。
lines.en: I hit the ground and lost a screw.
The wood soaked up water and grew heavy.

lines.zh: 我被炸得散了架，又拼回来。
lines.en: The blast scattered me; I pieced myself back.

lines.zh: 箭卡在木头里，晃来晃去。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in the wood and wobbles back and forth.
Something is tugging at my strings.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可也开始钝了。
lines.en: I do not eat, and yet I am dulling.

lines.zh: 雷击把木头劈出一道焦痕。
lines.en: Lightning left a scorched line in my wood.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，线还在往上拉。
lines.en: I fall, and the strings still pull upward.
